scope: One shared set of 100 fixed evaluation graphs for graphcolor_luna and graphcolor_muse; earlier complementary studies, separate from the 8,400-trial controlled study.

generator.distribution: Local greedy-solvable generation inspired by Reasoning Gym, not its official distribution.

witness_note: Saved valid colourings are included as task-solvability witnesses; these are dataset metadata rather than model-generated trial outputs.

budget_violation_policy.interpretation: Post-start amended end-to-end score; budget violations are operational zeros, NOT reasoning errors. Actual usage may exceed call allocations and is NOT clipped.
